# Create a 2-qubit circuit
qc = QuantumCircuit(2)

# Define the oracle
oracle = QuantumCircuit(2)
oracle.z(0)  # Good state = first qubit is |1>

grover_op = grover_operator(oracle, insert_barriers=True)

qc.append(grover_op, range(2))

# Measure the qubits
qc.measure_all()

from qiskit.circuit.library import HGate, CXGate, SwapGate

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)

# Apply Hadamard gates to both qubits
qc.append(HGate(), [0])
qc.append(HGate(), [1])

# Apply CNOT gate between qubits
qc.append(CXGate(), [0, 1])

# Apply SWAP gate between qubits
qc.append(SwapGate(), [0, 1])

# Apply another CNOT gate between qubits
qc.append(CXGate(), [0, 1])

# Apply Hadamard gates to both qubits again
qc.append(HGate(), [0])
qc.append(HGate(), [1])

# Uncompute the first CNOT gate
qc.append(CXGate().inverse(), [0, 1])

# Uncompute the SWAP gate
qc.append(SwapGate().inverse(), [0, 1])

# Uncompute the second CNOT gate
qc.append(CXGate().inverse(), [0, 1])

# Uncompute the Hadamard gates
qc.append(HGate().inverse(), [0])
qc.append(HGate().inverse(), [1])

    qc.append(RZ(gamma), [qubit])

qc.append(CNOT(), [1, 2])
